LanguageData.Megamod_Messages_EnabledHelp: Use the configured offsets and screen fitting. Disabling restores native placement without changing saved offsets.
LanguageData.Megamod_Messages_PositionOffsetHelp: Adjust both coordinates together, from −100% to +100% of the current screen size. Negative offsets can overlap the colonist bar. Keeping messages on screen takes priority; oversized stacks may be clipped. Apply changes both values in this column only.
LanguageData.Megamod_Messages_ResetPairHelp: Reset only this column. Use global and the other column remain unchanged.
LanguageData.Megamod_Messages_InvalidOffsetPair: Enter two finite numbers between −100 and 100.
LanguageData.Megamod_Messages_BarIntegrationPending: Automatic bar clearance is not yet integrated.
